name: Rest-of-day hedging momentum
note: One hard-scheduled decision per session. offset_min before the closing bar, measure rROD = log(price / the PREVIOUS session's closing price) -- a fixed-clock cumulative return that deliberately includes the overnight gap, not a bar-count lookback. Above +thr go long, below -thr go short, otherwise stand aside; the position is closed market-on-close the same session, so entry and exit times are constants rather than signal-driven. The closing bar is found from the data itself as the minute-of-day bucket with the largest median volume inside the plausible US close window, which uses no price information and survives DST and any bar size; close_min pins it manually. No profit target and no stop, because the published rule is a timed hold and a stop would truncate the effect being measured.
source: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (2021), 'Hedging demand and market intraday momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 142(1), 377-403; full text at https://academicweb.nd.edu/~zda/intramom.pdf. Sharpe 0.87-1.73 at asset-class level across 60+ futures markets, 1974-2020, with the negative-dealer-gamma mechanism verified directly in the paper.
